title: AussieWIRE Autofarm
features:
Anti Death:
- A feature designed to prevent your character from dying by automatically reviving or using protective measures when your health reaches critical levels.

Anti Death v2:
- An enhanced version of the Anti Death feature with additional safeguards, such as quicker response time and more advanced health monitoring, to ensure survival in more challenging situations.

Distance & Money Autofarmer:
- An automated tool that collects resources, completes tasks, or farms currency without user input, ensuring efficient farming over long distances or periods of time.

Farm Speed:
- The rate at which resources are gathered or tasks are completed in an automated farming process, allowing users to increase the pace of earning in-game rewards or currency.

Height:
- Adjusts the elevation of your character within the game, useful for reaching inaccessible areas or avoiding in-game hazards.

Auto Get On Bike:
- Automatically mounts or gets on your bike when the appropriate conditions are met, allowing for seamless travel and mobility within the game.

Claim Hourly Rewards:
- Automates the process of collecting hourly rewards or bonuses in-game, ensuring that you never miss out on valuable resources or in-game currency.
